load_off_mesh: load a 3D mesh from an OFF file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object with vertices and faces
save_off_mesh: save a PyTorch3D Meshes object to an ASCII OFF file with optional vertex and face colors
read_off_stream: read mesh data from a binary file stream and return vertices, faces, and colors as a dictionary
write_off_data: write vertex coordinates, faces, and optional colors to a binary file in OFF format
parse_off_faces: parse face data from an OFF file stream handling variable vertex counts and optional color channels
